lore_overview: Directly linked to Operator Surtr from historical Rhodes Island records. Laevatain shares Surtr's Sarkaz lineage, fiery Arts manifestation, weapon affinities, and the haunting presence of the Twilight Flaming Giant.

key_dialogue_excerpts.line: Voice of Surtr: 'From now on, you shall only follow one voice. Surtr's voice, my voice.'
What you saw is probably Laevatain, a reconvener with close ties to Surtr.
The colossal avatar of flame materializes above the volcanic ridge, roaring in resonance with Laevatain's blade.
Personnel are strictly prohibited from questioning Laevatain regarding Surtr or treating her as a mere facsimile of the historical Operator.
